Bug_Title: Child class methods named for parent class methods should be overrides
Bug_Explanation: The child class method getSalary() has the same name as the parent class method getName(). This is not an override as the parent class method is private.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug in the getSalaryBug() method of Employee class. The method getSalaryBug() calls the getSalary() method of Employee class, which is not an override of the getSalary() method of Person class. This results in calling Person's getSalary() method, which is private. As a result, the program throws a compile-time error.
